outcome.assessment: The response budget removed every per-binding row while retaining only an aggregate binding count. This prevented inspection of which available capabilities were represented in context responses and how recorded invocations related to exact bindings.
outcome.interpretation_limit: This is a bounded projection detail-loss observation. It does not establish that agents failed to discover, receive, or use the capabilities.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Capability delivery relationships disappear when response compaction removes binding rows
pressure_hypothesis.basis: An authenticated projection readback in this session showed nine capability bindings with no detailed rows after response-budget compaction. The pre-change implementation contained no compact relationship summary to preserve when rows were trimmed.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Preserve bounded counts for binding availability, context-response inclusion, use attribution, and response-to-use sequence, including exact-binding invocation counts, when detailed rows are omitted. Retain source-window and uncertainty qualifications.
